input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Candidate, User roles. It manages core business objects including user, address, employee identity, employee. It exposes interfaces for managing comment, post. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage address records, so that I can track and organize address data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage employee identity records, so that I can track and organize employee identity data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage employee records, so that I can track and organize employee data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to create and manage name records, so that I can track and organize name data effectively.
